title: WARNING: Top 3 Mistakes Buyers Make Relocating to Temple TX (2026)
description:
Three mistakes relocating buyers keep making in Temple, Belton, and Bell County — picking the house before the map, getting the payment math wrong, and assuming cheap means a good deal.
The full moving-to-Temple breakdown: https://templetxhomes.net/moving-to-temple-tx/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=description&utm_campaign=moving-to-temple-tx&utm_content=-hsAsGZVcVI
Free Temple Neighborhood Matcher — decision guide (PDF): https://templetxhomes.net/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/temple-neighborhood-matcher-decision-guide-2026.pdf

Moving to Temple, TX? Before you fall for the prettiest house at the cheapest price, watch this first. I'm Taylor Dasch with EG Realty, and these are the three mistakes I see relocating buyers make most often in Temple, Belton, and Bell County — the kind that cost real money after you've already closed.

Here's what we cover:
✅ Why location has to come before the house — and the Baylor Scott & White / Morgan's Point commute reality
✅ How to verify your school district by exact address (Temple ISD vs Belton ISD aren't where most people assume — especially 76502 / West Temple)
✅ The real monthly payment buyers get wrong: exemptions, MUD & PID districts, and the tax traps Zillow can't see
✅ Why "under asking price" doesn't mean you got a deal — how to read actual market value and days on market
